Bridge a source-space LM volume into BANC voxel coordinates

Source: R/lm_pipeline.R
lm_pipeline.Rd

Three-stage image-mode pipeline that lands a light-microscopy volume on the BANC EM voxel grid:

  1. IS2 -> FCWB via CMTK reformatx (image-mode resampling using the bridging registration shipped in nat.flybrains).

  2. FCWB -> JRC2018F via the saalfeldlab template-building RenderTransformed Java tool driven by the H5 displacement field (nat.jrcbrains/JRC2018F_FCWB.h5).

  3. JRC2018F -> BANC voxel space via Elastix transformix using bancr's bundled brain_240721/BANC_to_template.txt transform chain.

Output lands on the BANC precomputed grid (2400 x 924 x 789 at 400 nm) ready for nrrd_to_precomputed.

Unlike the earlier points-mode prototype, every stage runs in native code on full image volumes. Per-volume runtime on a recent Apple-silicon Mac with 8 threads:

  • Stage A (CMTK reformatx): ~30 s

  • Stage B (RenderTransformed): ~3 min

  • Stage C (transformix): ~1 min

  • Stage D (nrrd_to_precomputed): ~30 s

  • total: ~5 min/volume

is2_to_fcwb_cmtk(
  input,
  output,
  sample_space = "IS2",
  right_shift = 4L,
  verbose = TRUE
)

fcwb_to_jrc2018f_h5(
  input,
  output,
  h5_path = NULL,
  threads = 8L,
  verbose = TRUE
)

jrc2018f_to_banc_elastix(
  input,
  output,
  transform_dir = NULL,
  transformix = "transformix",
  verbose = TRUE
)

lm_to_banc_layer(
  input,
  gene,
  sample,
  channel = "02",
  dataset = "kondo_et_al_2020",
  output_dir,
  source_path = NULL,
  chunk_size = c(64L, 64L, 64L),
  keep_intermediates = FALSE,
  sample_space = "IS2",
  right_shift = 4L,
  threads = 8L,
  verbose = TRUE
)

Arguments

input

source-space NRRD path.

output

target output NRRD path on the BANC grid (uint8 gzipped NRRD).

sample_space

source template name (default "IS2").

right_shift

integer right-shift to apply to the source volume in Stage A (default 4 = 12-bit -> 8-bit).

verbose

logical; emit stage timing.

h5_path

path to a saalfeldlab H5 displacement field bridging FCWB -> JRC2018F. Defaults to nat.jrcbrains's JRC2018F_FCWB.h5.

threads

passed to fcwb_to_jrc2018f_h5.

transform_dir

directory holding the BANC Elastix transform chain (BANC_to_template.txt + 0/1/2/3_*.txt). Defaults to bancr's bundled brain_240721/.

transformix

path to the transformix binary (default "transformix", expected on PATH).

gene

short gene / receptor / peptide name (e.g. "GluRIIA"). Forms the precomputed dir name as {gene}_{sample}.

sample

sample identifier (e.g. "no1" for Kondo first-specimen samples; "no1" / "no2" are the two prepared brains in Kondo et al. 2020).

channel

source-stack channel string (default "02" = GFP / receptor channel for Kondo data; "01" would be the NC82 anatomical reference). Recorded in the registry only; the warping pipeline itself ignores this string.

dataset

master folder under light_level/ (default "kondo_et_al_2020").

output_dir

parent directory for intermediates + the final {gene}_{sample}.ng/ precomputed dir.

source_path

optional original storage path on the upstream repository; recorded in the registry entry.

chunk_size

length-3 integer chunk size for the precomputed layer. Default c(64, 64, 64) matches the public BANC atlas.

keep_intermediates

logical; keep the FCWB / JRC2018F / BANC intermediate NRRDs for inspection (default FALSE).

Value

path to the FCWB-aligned NRRD.

path to the JRC2018F-aligned NRRD.

path to the BANC-aligned NRRD.

list with precomputed_dir (filesystem path), registry_entry (one-row tibble), and timings (named numeric, seconds per stage).

External dependencies

  • CMTK reformatx on PATH, or set options(neuronbridger.cmtk_bin = "/path/to/cmtk-bin").

  • Elastix 5.x transformix on PATH.

  • Java 17+ runtime.

  • The saalfeldlab RenderTransformed fat JAR. By default looked up at ~/.local/share/neuronbridger/render-transformed.jar; override with the env var NEURONBRIDGER_XFORMIMAGE_JAR or options(neuronbridger.xformimage_jar = "/abs/path/to.jar").

  • nat.jrcbrains H5 registrations downloaded via nat.jrcbrains::download_saalfeldlab_registrations().

To build the JAR locally:


git clone https://github.com/saalfeldlab/template-building.git
cd template-building
# remove the unresolvable org.itc dependency (RenderTransformed
# does not use it)
sed -i '' '/<groupId>org.itc<\/groupId>/,/<\/dependency>/d' pom.xml
mvn package -DskipTests
mkdir -p ~/.local/share/neuronbridger
cp target/application-jar-with-dependencies.jar \
   ~/.local/share/neuronbridger/render-transformed.jar

Status

Hidden / internal helper while we benchmark across the Kondo glutamate-receptor library. If stable, propose upstream as a thin xformimage.h5reg wrapper for nat.h5reg.
